slides.title: ProcessPoolExecutor vs ThreadPoolExecutor
slides.prompt: When should you choose ProcessPoolExecutor over ThreadPoolExecutor in Python concurrency?
options: For CPU-bound tasks requiring bypass of the Global Interpreter Lock (GIL)
To reduce total RAM overhead across tasks
When working exclusively with AsyncIO coroutines
slides.correctAnswer: For CPU-bound tasks requiring bypass of the Global Interpreter Lock (GIL)
